command:
set -u
D=/var/jb/usr/macOS/lib
echo "-- verify upload hashes --"
shasum -a256 /tmp/libmachook_arm64e.new /tmp/libmachook_arm64.new
for f in libmachook_arm64e libmachook_arm64; do
  case $f in *arm64e) A=arm64e;; *) A=arm64;; esac
  install -m755 /tmp/$f.new $D/$f.dylib.new.$$ || { echo "install fail $f"; exit 1; }
  ldid -S $D/$f.dylib.new.$$ 2>&1 || { echo "ldid fail $f"; exit 1; }
  mv $D/$f.dylib.new.$$ $D/$f.dylib
done
echo "-- post-sign hashes --"
shasum -a256 $D/libmachook_arm64e.dylib $D/libmachook_arm64.dylib $D/libmachook.dylib
for f in libmachook_arm64e libmachook_arm64; do
  /var/jb/usr/bin/jbctl trustcache add $D/$f.dylib 2>&1 | tail -2
done
rm -f /tmp/libmachook_arm64e.new /tmp/libmachook_arm64.new
echo "-- baseline --"
/var/jb/usr/bin/chroot /var/mnt/rootfs /bin/echo HI
echo "BASELINE_RC=$?"
